me.about:
Currently studying Systems Analysis and Development, I also hold a Bachelor's and Licentiate degree in Biological Sciences from the University of São Paulo (USP), with an MBA in Data Science & Analytics. My multidisciplinary trajectory combines experience in education, scientific research, and software development, providing an analytical approach focused on problem-solving and delivering high-impact solutions.

I worked as a Science teacher and laboratory technician in Geology and Paleontology, a period during which I developed my first software project: the educational portal for the Institute of Geosciences at USP, which currently serves over 20,000 monthly users and records more than 2 million impressions per month, consolidating practical experience in developing applications for education and science communication.

Currently, my focus is on web and mobile application development using React, React Native, Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, SQL, Git, GitHub, and Jest. I have been deepening my studies and projects in Spec-Driven Development (SDD), using specifications as the foundation for planning, implementing, and validating features, aiming to build more consistent, testable software aligned with business requirements.

I am seeking opportunities as a Full Stack Developer, contributing with software development, engineering best practices, automated testing, application architecture, and continuous learning.
